features:
🌌 Orbital Energy Balls V1.0 - Cinematic Aura
Orbital Energy Balls is a premium-feel visual enhancement script for your Roblox character. It summons three high-intensity neon orbs that rotate around you in a synchronized, wave-like pattern. Designed for players who want a "Guardian" or "Cyberpunk" aesthetic, this script provides both a stunning visual aura and a functional light source.
📜 Key Features
Triple-Orb Synchronization: Three perfectly spaced energy orbs that follow you everywhere.
Smooth Orbital Physics: Uses CFrame and Sine Wave math for fluid, non-glitchy movement.
Dynamic Lighting: Each orb features a built-in PointLight to illuminate dark maps and corridors.
Zero-Fling Technology: Set to CanCollide = false and Anchored = true, meaning it will never interfere with your movement or cause physics bugs.
✅ Pros (Advantages)
Performance Friendly: Highly optimized code that won't lag your game, even on mobile devices.
Aesthetic Appeal: Uses Cyan Neon materials for a clean, futuristic look.
Instant Load: No complex setup required—just execute and watch the orbs appear.
❌ Cons (Disadvantages)
Local Visuals: Only you can see the orbs; they are client-side to ensure maximum performance and privacy.
Visual Only: These orbs are purely for style and lighting; they do not deal damage to enemies.
